from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_announced_treasury_qt_cap_path_v1'
assert not (out/'model_protocol.json').exists() and not (out/'run_started.json').exists(), '模型已经登记或执行，禁止重复注册'
source=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
gate=json.loads((out/'source_gate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert gate['passed'] and gate['source_eligible_events']==38
old=json.loads((root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1/model_protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
old_freeze=json.loads((root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1/model_freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
inputs=list(old_freeze['input_hashes'])
inputs.extend([
 'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1/model_protocol.json',
 'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1/result.json',
 'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_all_revision_prior_policy_sources_v1/result.json'
])
input_hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in inputs}
for name,h in old_freeze['input_hashes'].items(): assert input_hashes[name]==h, '原纠正后模型输入或辅助函数发生变化'
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
features_control=old['features_control']
feature=source['candidate_field']
protocol={
 'study_id':source['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E15','registered_at':now,
 'phase':'SINGLE_FIXED_UPSTREAM_ANNOUNCED_CAP_PATH_INCREMENT',
 'hypothesis':source['hypothesis'],'why_different':source['why_different'],
 'source_gate_status':gate['status'],
 'fields':[feature],'feature_definition':source['candidate_definition'],
 'feature_units':'十亿美元原路径上限之和；不按收益取正负、差分、除数或阈值。',
 'source_join':'沿68原事件来源对齐；38合格/30明确路径前未准入。政策根available_at<=decision_at，目标三个整月仅按当时已公开生效路径。源有效性按明示政策及32原声明核续行，非延长旧季度预估年龄。',
 'source_root_dependence':'四上限政策根、2022预告台阶非新增根；记录各训练池、预测及高分的根复用。',
 'event_universe':old['event_universe'],'features_control':features_control,'features_joint':features_control+[feature],
 'training':old['training'],'tree':old['tree'],'label':old['label'],'score':old['score'],'evaluation':old['evaluation'],
 'comparisons':['同事件/同成熟池11字段控制树','同池12字段单原因联合树','同12字段alpha10标准化岭回归仅参考','同成熟池标签平均'],
 'primary_period':old['primary_period'],'earlier_context':old['earlier_context'],
 'increment_gate':{
  'primary_joint_mse_not_worse_than_matched_control':True,
  'primary_joint_high_mean_net5_positive':True,
  'primary_joint_high_mean_not_worse_than_matched_control_when_nonempty':True,
  'at_least_one_primary_joint_high_window_not_in_control_or_parent_M2':True,
  'at_least_one_primary_new_high_path_actually_uses_cap_field':True
 },
 'account_admission':old['account_admission'],'account_targets':old['account_targets'],
 'selection_disclosure':'E1—E14及旧M2历史已经观察。新字段源状态已看过，尚未读取本E15股票分组收益或拟合；仍是历史开发，非独立验证。',
 'single_fixed_run':True,'parameter_searches':0,
 'E6_E9_E12_rejections_preserved':True,'E11_original_gate_failure_preserved':True,
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
 'new_repository_source_code_edits':0,'independent_validation':False,'goal_achieved':False
}
def save(name,d):
 with (out/name).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(d,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
save('model_protocol.json',protocol)
save('model_freeze.json',{
 'registered_at':now,'before_E15_equity_labels_or_fits':True,
 'model_protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'model_protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'source_protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'source_gate_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'source_gate.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'event_source_alignment_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'68原事件上游路径来源对齐.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'policy_roots_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'四政策根及明示生效路径.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'input_hashes':input_hashes,
 'source_hashes':{r['path']:r['sha256'] for r in json.loads((out/'source_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))},
 'risk_contract_snapshot':old_freeze['risk_contract_snapshot'],'execution_assets':old_freeze['execution_assets'],
 'model_selection_or_parameter_searches':0
})
print('E15模型在新收益读取前已登记：11对照/12联合单字段；原成熟池、两层叶6、5间隔费用和80线不变。')
print('独立验证未建立；仅全部固定增量条件通过后才能另登记完整账户。')
